title: Task Manager Create Task Templates
summary:
Administrators can learn about the different options available when new tasks are created, including
- Assign team, preparer, approver, and number of approvers.
- Allow Co-Preparation.
- Description and procedure
- task due time
- The task types task list and auto-recurring
- Offset zero-day
- Reminders
- Time zone
- Attachments
- Checklist
- Additional information such as company, department, frequency, and internal control
- Extra fields
